output.title: pixelmuse: AI Product Photo Upscaler
output.tagline: Supplier photos in, catalog-ready images out — 4x upscaled.
output.description_short: AI background cleanup and 4x upscaling built for product catalogs. Batch-process thousands of SKUs overnight. Now in beta — 50 free credits on signup.
output.description_long:
**pixelmuse** turns messy supplier shots into catalog-ready product images — automatically.

Unlike generic AI upscalers trained on portraits and art, pixelmuse uses models tuned specifically on product photography. That means label text stays sharp, fabric textures stay crisp, and you don't spend hours fixing AI hallucinations.

**What it does:**
- **4x upscaling** — a 12MP product image processed in 9 seconds
- **Background cleanup** — remove clutter and correct lighting in one pass
- **Batch API + CSV workflow** — process an entire catalog overnight, not one image at a time
- **Store-level presets** — keep every image in your catalog visually consistent

Three Shopify agencies already use pixelmuse in their standard listing workflow. During beta, 38,000 images have been processed and counting.

**pixelmuse is currently in beta.** The self-serve credit billing and batch API are live. Pricing is usage-based at $0.04 per image, with 50 free credits on signup — enough to test a full product category before you commit.

Built for Shopify merchants and e-commerce agencies managing 200 to 20,000 SKUs. If a store redesign, marketplace onboarding, or supplier import just handed you hundreds of substandard images, this is the tool for that job.
screenshot_order: 1st — Before/after split of a real supplier photo: blurry low-res input vs crisp 4x upscaled output with clean background. Leads with the core result and makes the value undeniable at a glance.
2nd — Batch dashboard showing a CSV upload in progress with a queue of 200+ images and a progress bar. Proves the catalog-scale workflow claim visually.
3rd — Store preset panel showing consistent lighting and background applied across a grid of 12 product images. Demonstrates the consistency differentiator that agencies care about.

faq.q: Will it smear the text on my product labels or blur fabric patterns?
faq.a: No. pixelmuse models are trained on product photography specifically, so label text and fabric texture stay sharp — that's the core difference from generic upscalers.

faq.q: Is it really in beta? Is my data safe?
faq.a: Yes, pixelmuse is in public beta. Credit billing and the batch API are live and stable. Image data is processed and not stored beyond delivery. Expect active updates weekly.

faq.q: How does the pricing work for a large catalog?
faq.a: Usage-based at $0.04 per image. 50 free credits on signup. A 1,000-image catalog costs $40. No subscription required — pay only for what you process.

faq.q: Can my dev team integrate this into our existing workflow?
faq.a: Yes. The batch API accepts CSV input and is documented. SDKs are on the roadmap. Most agencies connect it via the API or use the CSV upload in the dashboard.

faq.q: Does it work for any product type, or just apparel?
faq.a: It handles any product category — electronics, homeware, food packaging, apparel. The models are tuned on diverse product photography, not a single vertical.

output.cta: Start with 50 free credits — no subscription needed.

confidence.notes: Strong profile with concrete proof points and clear differentiators. Beta stage disclosed as required. No third-party validation or named logos available, so listing relies on internal claims. No current listing was provided so changes_from_current is empty.
